title: System
description: packages.system: the installation and how it runs.

instance.title: Installation
instance.description: The name of this installation: its stage, then a dot and the machine. DEV.ojhome, STAGING, LIVE. The stage decides the defaults that differ between stages.

website.title: Website
website.description: The names of the project, the same on every installation.

name.title: Name
name.description: The name of the website: the title of the pages, the name of the web app.

appName.title: App name
appName.description: The name on the sign-in pages and in the admin. Empty: the name.

titleSeparator.title: Title separator
titleSeparator.description: Between the parts of a page title, and in the subject of a mail.

legal.title: Legal
legal.description: What the sign-in pages of this system link and show about who runs it. The website has its own imprint and privacy pages.

imprintUrl.title: Imprint
imprintUrl.description: Where the imprint link of the sign-in pages leads: an http(s) URL or a path starting with /. Empty: the /imprint/ page of the website.

privacyUrl.title: Privacy policy
privacyUrl.description: Where the privacy link of the sign-in pages leads: an http(s) URL or a path starting with /. Empty: the /privacy/ page of the website.

operator.title: Responsible operator
operator.description: Who runs this system, shown on the privacy page of the sign-in. Empty: the start page of the admin reminds of it.

dpo.title: Data protection officer
dpo.description: If one is appointed: shown on the privacy page of the sign-in.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: What a developer sees while working on the installation. On by default on DEV, off everywhere else.

debug.title: Debug
debug.description: The debug output and the debug tool. Render time and script time only work while it is on.

render.title: Render time
render.description: Records which template and panel rendered each part of the page, for the layer trees of the debug tool. Costs time on every request.

time.title: Script time
time.description: Defines DEBUGTIME. Nothing in the packages reads it at the moment.

displayErrors.title: Display PHP errors
displayErrors.description: PHP shows its errors in the page (display_errors). Errors are logged either way. Independent of Debug.

versionAppendix.title: Version appendix
versionAppendix.description: Appended to asset URLs, so browsers load a new version. time: the current time, every request a new one. Not set: versionDate.

versionDate.title: Version date
versionDate.description: The release the installation runs, appended to asset URLs when no version appendix is set. Empty: nothing is appended.

assets.title: Assets
assets.description: How scripts and styles of the packages reach the browser. source: straight from their folders. serve: through /assets/, from the originals every time. publish: through /assets/, copied to public/assets/. Not set: the originals where the web reaches them, copies where it does not.

sysPath.title: System path
sysPath.description: Where the system package lies, relative to the project folder.

ini.title: PHP settings
ini.description: Set with ini_set() on every request. Upload limits do not belong here, PHP cannot change them at runtime.

max_execution_time.title: Max. execution time
max_execution_time.description: Seconds a request may run before PHP stops it. 0: no limit.

memory_limit.title: Memory limit
memory_limit.description: How much memory one request may take, e.g. 512M or 1G.

serialize_precision.title: Serialize precision
serialize_precision.description: Digits of floating point numbers in serialize() and json_encode().

log_errors.title: Log errors
log_errors.description: PHP writes its errors to the error log.

html_errors.title: HTML errors
html_errors.description: PHP formats the errors it shows as HTML.

constants.title: Constants
constants.description: Defined as PHP constants when the configuration is loaded.

DEFAULT_TABLE_PREFIX.title: Table Prefix
DEFAULT_TABLE_PREFIX.description: Put before the name of every table of the system: cms_nodes.

PROJECT_NAMESPACE.title: Project namespace
PROJECT_NAMESPACE.description: The PHP namespace of the project's classes. Also names its live update channels when the relay has no prefix.

ACCOUNT_WHITELIST.title: Allowed mail domains
ACCOUNT_WHITELIST.description: Who may create an account. Empty: everybody.

auth.title: Sign-in
auth.description: How people sign in, and how long they stay signed in.

defaultSignInMethod.title: Default sign-in
defaultSignInMethod.description: What the sign-in card opens with. Empty: the person picks.

deviceDays.title: Device days
deviceDays.description: How long a device stays signed in.

screenDays.title: Screen days
screenDays.description: How long a screen lives after its last use. Empty: until revoked.

secret.title: Sign-in key
secret.description: Keys the one-time codes. Made the first time it is needed.

mail.title: Mail
mail.description: Without an account, DEV hands the mail to Mailpit and every other stage refuses to send.

host.title: SMTP host
host.description: The server mail is handed to. Empty on DEV: the local mail catcher (127.0.0.1:1025).

secure.title: Encryption
secure.description: tls: STARTTLS on the port, ssl: encrypted from the start, none: plain text.

user.title: User
user.description: The account name at the SMTP host.

password.title: Password
password.description: The password of the SMTP user.

from.title: From address
from.description: The sender of every mail. The SMTP host has to allow it.

fromName.title: From name
fromName.description: The name shown with the from address.

testMode.title: Test mode
testMode.description: Every To, CC and BCC goes to the test recipient instead. DEV always routes like this, even when the switch is off: it is for LIVE and STAGING.

testRecipient.title: Test recipient
testRecipient.description: Where test routing sends every mail. Empty: testmail@fluxo.systems. An invalid address blocks delivery.
